senses.gloss:
Execrate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSap 1 U, AkruS 1 P, garh 1, 10 A, aBiSaMs 1 P.
Ⓝ[Execrat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹSApaH, A-kroSaH, aBiSaMsanaM.
ⓃExecrable,Ⓒa.Ⓓgarhya, garhaRIya, aDama, nIca; See Accursed.

Execute,Ⓒv. t.ⒹanuzWA 1 P, saM-niH-pad c., kf 8 U, vi-DA 3 U, A-car 1 P, nirvah c., sAD 5 P or c., nirvft c.; ‘e(xecute) thy business’ svaniyogamaSUnyaM kuru.
Ⓑ
 2 han 2 P, vyA-pad c., prARadaMqaM-dehadaMqaM-AdiS 6 P, daMq 10; ‘he was ordered to be e(xecut)ed’ tasya vaDa-deha-daMqa AdizwaH, vaDyatAmasO iti AdizwaM.
Ⓝ[Execut]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹanuzWAnaM, AcaraRaM, viDAnaM, karaRaM, saMpAdanaM, nizpatti-sidDi f., nirvAhaH-haRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 GAtaH, hananaM, hatyA, vyApAdanaM, vaDaH; ‘place of e(xecution)’ vaDyasTAnaM-BUmiH f.; ‘sentence of e(xecution)’ prARadaMqaH, uttamasAhasaM.
Ⓝ[Execut]ioner,Ⓒs.ⒹGAtakaH, mAtaMgaH, daMqapASikaH, vaDyApuruzaH, vaDADikftaH.
Ⓝ[Execut]ive,Ⓒa.ⒹnirvAhaka, nizpAdaka viDAyaka, kAryakzama, anuzWAnaniyukta, kAryanirvAhaka.
Ⓝ[Execut]or,Ⓒs.ⒹmftaleKADikArin m., (mftasya) uttarasADakaH.

Exempt,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓmuc 6 P or c., mokz 10, vi-ava-sfj 6 P, vfj 1 P, 10; ‘e(xempt) from fine’ daMqAdAnaM, kzam 1 A; ‘e(xempt) from taxes’ karAdAnaM anujYA 9 U.
Ⓝ[Exempt]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓmukta, varjita, hIna, rahita; oft. by a, nir, vi, vIta, gata, in comp.; ‘e(xempted) from pride’ gatAvalepa, vItadarpa, agarva, &c.; ‘e(xempted) from avarice’ nirloBa, vitfzRa, loBarahita, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 anA-yatta, avaSa.
Ⓝ[Exempt]ion,Ⓒs.Ⓓmukti f., mokzaH, varjanaM, rahitatvaM, mocanaM, aBAvaH; oft. by a or an in comp.; anavalepaH ‘e(xemption) from pride’, daMqABAvaH ‘e(xemption) from fine’ &c.

Exercise,Ⓒs.ⒹprayogaH, vyApAraH, anuzWAnaM, AcaraRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 aByAsaH, nivezaRaM, aByastatA Avftti f., caryA.
Ⓑ
 3 vyavasAyaH, dyamaH, cezwA, udyogaH, vyApAraH; ‘bodily e(xercise)’ vyAyAmaH, pariSramaH; ‘materials for taking e(xercise)’ vyAyAmopakaraRAni; ‘military e(xercise)’ raRa-SikzA, SastrAByAsaH, yudDAByAsaH; ‘shooting e(xercise)’ SarAByAsaH, upAsanaM; ‘usual e(xercise)’ nityakftyaM.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓapa-pra-yuj 7 A, 10, vyA-pf c.
Ⓑ
 2 aByas 4 U; (sadA) Acar 1 P, anuzWA 1 P, A-ni-sev 1 A, anu-pari-SIl 10; A-yas c., vyA-yam c.; ‘e(xercise) soldiers’ Sikz c., raRaSikzAM dA 3 U; ‘e(xercise) oneself’ vyAyam 1 P, udyam, vyava-so 4 P, cezw 1 A; vyAyAmaM-SarIraSramaM-kf 8 U.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹpariSramaM-vyAyAmaM-kf; ‘e(xercis)ed with an iron club’ ayodaMqena Sramamakarot (Ka. 76).

Exert,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓni-pra-upa-yuj 7 A, 10, vyA-pf c., pravfta c.; ‘e(xert) oneself’ prayat 1 A, cezw 1 A, udyam 1 P, vyava-so 4 P, pravft 1 A; ‘e(xert) oneʼs utmost’ yAvacCakyaM prayat.
Ⓝ[Exert]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹvyavasAyaH, utsAhaH, cezwA, vyApAraH, cezwitaM, karmayogaH, yatnaH, udyamaH, udyogaH; See Attempt.
Ⓑ
 2 AyAsaH, SramaH, pariSramaH, kAyakleSaH-AyAsaH.
